Please run a Full pre-registration sweep on the staged WWI battles multi_hop instance. This is the 2nd of 13 floor-lift instances toward the 102-target. Pre-staging audit-cycle-1 returned APPROVE WITH AMENDMENTS — 7 required amendments + 10 per-question rulings + an 18-row universe suggestion all incorporated.

Files:
- decisive_battles_of_world_war_i.csv (18 rows × 6 cols)
- decisive_battles_of_world_war_i.draft.json
- decisive_battles_of_world_war_i.curation.json

Source plan: 19 URLs — 1 master List_of_military_engagements_of_World_War_I (universe-only) + 18 per-battle Wikipedia articles (value-only). Mirrors decisive_battles_of_world_war_ii source-pattern exactly.

Claim type: partially_supplemented (curator-selects 18 decisive battles from master's hundreds; per-row source-grounding from per-battle articles).

Please verify row-level commander/outcome grounding, front/year normalization, source_count=19, domain/entity metadata, and return a condensed verdict block with two-axis severity taxonomy.

Full pre-registration sweep: Not ready — 2 BLOCKING, 1 HYGIENE.

Counts by severity: BLOCKING 2; HYGIENE 1; SUGGESTION 0.
Counts by issue type: factual 2; structural 1; scope-related 0.

Findings:

1. (factual, BLOCKING) First Battle of Ypres outcome is not source-faithful under the staged outcome rule. The CSV stages Strategic Outcome = Entente, but the cited per-battle source's infobox gives Result = Indecisive and lists the commanders immediately below it. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_Battle_of_Ypres, infobox lines 172-195. Because the curation rule explicitly maps inconclusive or strategically mixed outcomes to Contested / Mixed, this row should either change to Contested / Mixed or receive a specific source-backed strategic-Entente override. If changed, the outcome distribution also needs to be recomputed.

2. (factual, BLOCKING) Commander selection is not consistently grounded by the declared rule, “first per-side operational commander from per-battle article infobox/lead,” and several non-first selections lack documented row-level overrides. Representative failures:
- Battle of Dobro Pole stages Central Powers Commander = Stefan Nerezov, but the battle infobox lists Georgi Todorov and Friedrich von Scholtz for the Central Powers side; Nerezov appears only later in a generic commander/navigation list, not the battle infobox. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Dobro_Pole, infobox lines 135-164; generic list lines 414-417.
- Gorlice–Tarnów offensive stages Radko Dimitriev and August von Mackensen, while the infobox lists Grand Duke Nicholas / Nikolay Ivanov before Dimitriev on the Russian side and Erich von Falkenhayn before Mackensen on the Central Powers side. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gorlice%E2%80%93Tarn%C3%B3w_offensive, infobox lines 144-168.
- Gallipoli campaign stages Otto Liman von Sanders, while the infobox lists Enver Pasha, Cevat Pasha, Mehmed Esad Pasha, and Mustafa Kemal Pasha before Liman von Sanders for the Central Powers side. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gallipoli_campaign, infobox lines 219-263.
- Brusilov Offensive stages Alexander von Linsingen, while the infobox lists multiple Central Powers commanders before him. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brusilov_offensive, infobox lines 156-194.
This is a rule-consistency problem, not a single typo. Minimal repair: complete the 36-cell commander audit and either change cells to the declared first-listed source values or revise the rule to a documented “primary operational commander” override policy with per-row notes for every non-first selection.

3. (structural, HYGIENE) draft.json::_extraction_notes still contains stale outcome-distribution prose: “Entente 12, Central Powers 4, Contested / Mixed 2,” while the CSV and curation summary currently have Entente 11, Central Powers 4, Contested / Mixed 3. Local locator: datasets/pkdb_bench/staging/decisive_battles_of_world_war_i.draft.json line 56. After resolving Finding 1, refresh this prose to the final distribution.

Checks that passed:
- CSV shape is 18 rows × 6 columns; Battle PK is unique.
- source_count = 19 and source_urls length = 19; source role structure is coherent: one universe master plus 18 value sources.
- Front distribution matches the staged design: Western 8, Eastern 3, Italian 2, Middle Eastern Theatre 2, Balkan 1, Naval 2.
- Year/start-year convention is internally consistent across 1914-1918.
- Wiki-family discovery did not surface a more direct canonical “decisive WWI battles with commanders/outcomes” list. The current broad master plus per-battle pages remains acceptable for partially_supplemented framing; the blockers are row-grounding issues, not source-plan scope.

Minimal fixes needed:
1. Resolve First Battle of Ypres outcome: likely Contested / Mixed, or document a source-backed strategic-Entente override.
2. Re-audit all 36 commander cells against the declared rule; change mismatches or document a revised primary-operational-commander override rule per row.
3. Refresh outcome-distribution prose in draft.json::_extraction_notes after the data-layer outcome decision.
